nom: Bioderma Hydrabio H2O Micellar Water Face Cleanser for Dehydrated Skin

avis.titre: I forgot how good a GOOD micellar water is
avis.texte: I've been buying decent micellar waters for a while for makeup removal at the end of the day, and I forgot how gentle and lovely a GOOD micellar water feels on the skin at the end of the day. It's soothing, gentle, and solidly gets off most of my makeup. Any stubborn bits I can use some pond's cold cream on, and then go back in with this gentle guy before going in with the face wash for the evening. Excited to try others of this micellar brand!

Removes makeup and sunscreen, very gentle first step cleanser for my skin and non-stripping. I use a separate remover for waterproof mascara, but everything else it can handle. I'm allergic to the pink top Bioderma so I'm very happy with this one.

avis.titre: Love the blue, switch to pink for winter
avis.texte: Amazing product, love, love, love. Use this, then some toner. Amazing! Doesn't dry out skin, use a bit of toner after and good to go. For those with stinging in the eyes, I don't use so much product that it gets into my eyes, never had a problem. A little goes a long way. Staple
Do not buy. Tried it for the first time and burns your eye. Doesn't take off eye make-up. Eye is red and swollen. Do not recommend.

I read this was good for sensitive eyes and skin. I don't think I have ever had a worse experience with a MU remover. My eyes immediately burned, and I had bloodshot eyes, which I have never had, even with my very dry eyes. Tread lightly with this. I am a MU artist and esthetician, so not a woman with no experience in this field.

avis.titre: Better than the for oily skin version
avis.texte: My skin is quite oily especially on my t-zone but I can get dehydrated very easily. I like this version because it doesnt feel harsh or drying, which some may think is better for oily skin but drying it can cause more oil production. This product takes makeup off very easily especially if you hold for a few seconds on your eyes for eye makeup removal. I'm also easily acne prone and this hasn't given me any issues. Sometimes I also use it as a quick cleanser in the morning if I feel that my skin is a little sensitive and prefer not to wash with a foaming cleanser.

I've used Bioderma for years, but never tried the hydrating version. I love it! It quickly removes my makeup without making my skin feel tight or dry. It's definitely more hydrating than the original. Highly recommend this!

I've been using Bioderma micellar for so long I remember when they called it crealine water. In my 20s and 30s I used the standard (pink bottle) version. In my 40s I switched over to the blue. I love this product. It is the best eye makeup remover in existence. It's gentle and pleasant and doesn't strip my skin of crucial moisture. I love the subtle tingly feeling it gives. I love how valuable it is for fixing makeup smears etc. Travel friendly too: you can be without water access and still clean your face.
